text: {"overall_winner": "A", "qualities": [{"evidence": "multi-paragraph essay structure with an introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion", "quality": "structural organization", "description": "captures the logical division of an essay into distinct paragraphs that organize different supporting arguments."}, {"evidence": "phrases such as \"for example\", \"in contrast\", and \"for these reasons\"", "quality": "discourse transitions", "description": "captures the use of transitional expressions to connect ideas and guide the reader through the text."}, {"evidence": "clauses like \"because everyone get tired\", \"so is better less hours\", and \"if you spend more time... there is not enought time\"", "quality": "syntactic complexity", "description": "captures the ability to construct complete compound and complex sentences rather than disjointed word streams."}, {"evidence": "words like \"conserve\", \"resources\", \"disadvantages\", and \"responsabiliies\"", "quality": "topic vocabulary", "description": "captures the use of relevant domain-specific words to express concrete ideas."}]}
